mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_workflow (workflow_no, run_id, user_id, workflow_type, title, status, current_step_no, context_object_type, context_object_id, pause_reason, error_code, error_message, started_time, paused_time, resumed_time, completed_time, expires_time, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{workflowNo}, #{runId}, #{userId}, #{workflowType}, #{title}, #{status}, #{currentStepNo}, #{contextObjectType}, #{contextObjectId}, #{pauseReason}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{startedTime}, #{pausedTime}, #{resumedTime}, #{completedTime}, #{expiresTime}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_ai_workflow WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_workflow SET status = #{status}, pause_reason = #{pauseReason}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, paused_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PAUSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE paused_time END, resumed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUNNING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE resumed_time END, completed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END, edit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by = #{editBy} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}

UPDATE t_ai_workflow SET status = #{status}, current_step_no = #{currentStepNo}, pause_reason = #{pauseReason}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, started_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUNNING' AND started_time IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE started_time END, paused_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'PAUSED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE paused_time END, resumed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUNNING' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE resumed_time END, completed_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE completed_time END, edit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by = #{editBy} WHERE id = #{id}
